en.answer: Even if you do not have any "HERO" monsters in your Graveyard, you can activate the effect of <<12704>> when it is Normal or Special Summoned. During the End Phase of this turn, if you have a "HERO" monster in your Graveyard, you can then add it to your hand. (If you do not have a "HERO" monster in your Graveyard during the End Phase, the effect is not applied.)
en.question: If I do not have any "HERO" monsters in my Graveyard, can I activate the effect of <<12704>> when it is Normal or Special Summoned, that adds a "HERO" monster from my Graveyard to my hand during the End Phase?
en.title: If I do not have any "HERO" monsters in my Graveyard, can I activate the effect of <<12704>> when it is Normal or Special Summoned, that adds a "HERO" monster from my Graveyard to my hand during the End Phase?

ja.answer:
自分の墓地に「HERO」と名のついたモンスターが存在しない場合でも、召喚・特殊召喚に成功した「<<12704>>」のモンスター効果を発動する事はできます。

そのターンのエンドフェイズに、自分の墓地に「HERO」と名のついたモンスターが存在しているのであれば、その中から1体を選んで手札に加える事ができます。
（そのターンのエンドフェイズにも、自分の墓地に「HERO」と名のついたモンスターが存在しないのであれば、効果処理は適用されません。）
